approach: Static recompilation of the Gekko (PowerPC 750CL) code to C by an in-repo lifter, on a hand-written GameCube hardware layer; gcn-recomp's GX renderer and AX mixer.
notes: The Japanese release (Digimon Battle Chronicle) and the USA release (Digimon Rumble Arena 2). Complete four-player battles run at 58-60 fields/s on Windows, Linux and Android (measured on the Japanese release; the USA build uses the same runtime); saves are standard GameCube memory cards (MemoryCardA.raw). Built locally from your own disc: neither the repository nor its releases ship game data or a prebuilt game program, only a content-free self-build kit. Other regions, other revisions and the PS2/Xbox versions are rejected.
